models_evaluated: STATUS autonomous AI diabetic retinopathy screening system

links.outcome: AI image gradability and patient encounters after training-based intervention framework
links.effect: Gradability rose from 62.3% in Year 1 to 71.2% in Year 2; patient encounters increased by 21.9%. Uncontrolled pre-post comparison.
links.quote: Interventions, including enhanced training protocols and camera utilization reports, effectively improved screening efficiency.

unlisted_practices: Camera utilization reports fed back to clinic sites to improve AI screening image acquisition

links.outcome: AI image gradability and screening encounter volume following enhanced training within a bundled intervention
links.effect: With bundled interventions including enhanced training and camera utilization reports, gradability increased from 62.3% in Year 1 to 71.2% in Year 2; patient encounters increased by 21.9%. Training's independent effect was not isolated.
links.quote: The AI system's gradability increased from 62.3% in Year 1 to 71.2% in Year 2, comparable to non-mydriatic gradability rates observed in clinical trials.
